title: selaginella dregei var. welwitschiana
intro: Selaginella dregei var. welwitschiana, commonly known as Spiked Spike Moss, is a species of spore-producing plant in the family Selaginellaceae. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine, and it has been found to have several health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Spiked Spike Moss include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
